blocks.text: Roger is new to Beach Town. He doesn't bring his cellphone, so he is asking Jim for directions.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.text: Excuse me. Is there a department store around here?

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Yes, there's one on the corner of Happy Road and Second Street.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.text: I see. I also need to go to a bank.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Oh. Do you see A+ Supermarket just up Happy Road? There's a bank right across from the supermarket.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.text: Thanks. I also want to buy a book for my son. Is there a bookstore near here?

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Sure. There's a big one in the department store, and there's a smaller one on the corner of Third Street and Happy Road.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: If you want to buy picture books, the smaller one is right for you.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.text: Oh, yeah. I'll go there first. Thank you.
